card.title: Redmi Note 13 4G Not Charging

claims.statement: Redmi Note 13 4G that works but won't detect charging usually has a blown OVP IC from a faulty charger/cable; with only the charger connected, check VBUS 5 V, then OVP in and out.
If OVP output is missing, remove the OVP, confirm its pads aren't shorted, jumper VBUS_OVP_INPUT to VBUS_OVP_OUTPUT and mask; recommend replacing the charger and cable.

procedure: Measure VBUS 5 V, OVP in/out (charger only).
Remove OVP; check pads; bridge in to out; mask.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Bypassing the OVP removes over-voltage protection; the customer should replace their charger.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
